items.title: Harry "Chicken" Oscar Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: I like that other fella Higginbottom.

ctx.x: Oh, to change the subject, do you have any favorite trombone of all the different people you've heard any place in the country? Who do you like?
Well, the trombone players I like. I like that fella Tommy Dorsey. I like that other fella Higginbottom. And I like that boy in Chicago. What we was talking about. Roy Palmer.
Roy Palmer. Yeah. I remember you mentioned to me.
